title: Shipping and trade in Indonesia, Java, 1774-1777
authors: Dr G.J. Knaap, KITLV, Royal Netherlands Inst. of Southeast Asian & Caribbean Studies, (Koninklijk Instituut voor Taal-, Land en Volkenkunde)
descriptions: The dataset contains data on the technological developments and changes, the mobility, ethnicity, shipping, army and trade in the Netherlands East Indies in the period 1774-1777.
